Strategy rules

Strategy: 4h MACD Momentum

Enter long on a MACD bullish cross with strong volume

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN MACD line crosses above signal line (macd_bullish_cross) AND volume is above avg_vol
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price - atr_mult * atr_value(atr_period)

Exit long when MACD crosses below zero

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN MACD line crosses below zero (macd_zero_cross_down)
THEN close the position

Enter short on a MACD bearish cross with strong volume

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN MACD line crosses below signal line (macd_bearish_cross) AND volume is above avg_vol
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price + atr_mult * atr_value(atr_period)

Exit short when MACD crosses above zero

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN MACD line crosses above zero (macd_zero_cross_up)
THEN close the position
